# Reporting Issues

Found a bug, have a feature request, or need help? Use the GitHub issue tracker.

1. Go to [`github.com/cityresilience/city-scan/issues`](https://github.com/cityresilience/city-scan/issues)
2. Click **New issue**
3. Describe the problem or request clearly — include steps to reproduce for bugs, and the city name / scan ID if relevant
4. Assign the issue to yourself or a relevant team member
